content: Ruby 4.x doesn't exist - latest is Ruby 3.4.0 (Dec 2024). Jekyll 4.3.3 officially requires Ruby >= 2.5.0 but recommends Ruby 3.2+ for optimal compatibility. Running too-new Ruby with older Jekyll typically causes LoadError exceptions for gems removed from Ruby stdlib (csv, base64, bigdecimal in Ruby 3.4+) and Logger compatibility bugs with Ruby >= 3.3 fixed in Jekyll 4.3.3. Webrick must be added manually for Ruby 3.0+. Current setup (Jekyll 4.3.3 on Ruby 4.0.6) indicates misunderstanding - Ruby 4.0.6 doesn't exist, likely meant Ruby 3.4.x or similar.
